reason: Nineteen bucks is nothing to me, but a lot of what I pay goes to mechanics in cash on a scribbled nota or no paper at all, so a bot that only sees what lands in the chat won't show me where the money leaks. I might throw the free archive at it, but I'm not paying until I see it catch something I missed.
objection: Will it really flag the same fuel or parts receipt sent twice by two different guys, or is it just another receipt-to-spreadsheet bot that leaves me checking everything myself anyway?
would_change_my_mind: Running my old chat archive through the free tier and having it actually flag real duplicates or totals that don't add up that I hadn't caught.
